supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account ext.rwong was created at 13:44:07 UTC, shortly after the alert's approximate time of 13:42 UTC.
The account-creation event names nora.blake as the subject, and the domain controller recorded a network logon for nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01 shortly beforehand.
The ext.<name> account name and its observed addition to the Freelancers group match the organization's stated help-desk practice for temporary accounts.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage, so proxy activity during that interval cannot be assessed from the supplied proxy telemetry.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish whether ext.rwong was requested or approved, or who requested it.
The evidence does not establish the account's complete group memberships, including whether it received any other privileges.
The evidence does not show whether or when ext.rwong was subsequently used.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe launched under nora.blake, although the inventory says the organization has no VPN; these process records do not establish that a VPN connection occurred. Track separately, and do not use this to decide the account-creation alert. (T048-00009, T048-00010, T048-00011)
